{{Quote|The walking cadavers are a group of Weequay, led by a brutish thug named Siron Vurn'ke. Forget whatever you may have heard about Weequay&mdash;they're not as formidable as some would claim, especially not for a vicious killer like you.|[[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:LV" />}}
'''Siron Vurn'ke''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] criminal who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of a group of Weequay thugs working for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].<ref name="SWG:LV" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Jabba tasked Vurn'ke's hit squad with eliminating a skiled spacer loyal to [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]], the leader of the [[Valarian Syndicate]] and main rival of Jabba. However, Lady Valarian discovered the situation and warned her henchman. The spacer then found and attacked Vurn'ke and four Weequay zealots near [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. Siron Vurn'ke was killed in the firefight.<ref name="SWG:LV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Siron Vurn'ke was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:LV" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Siron Vurn'ke was present in the original release of the game, being part of [[W:c:swg:Valarian Theme Park (pre-NGE)|Lady Valarian's Quest Series]].<ref name="SWG:LV" />

With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 23 Notes for 31 August 2005|Publish 23]]" on [[August 31]], [[2005]], Lady Valarian's Quest Series was deactivated and Siron Vurn'ke was consequently removed from the game.<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=770|text=Update Notes: Publish 23}}</ref>
